gloss: regular time; scheduled time; regular working hours

definitions.gloss: regular working hours; official end of work time
definitions.explanation: The officially designated end time of the workday, without overtime.
A fixed, predetermined time for something to occur.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{定時|ていじ}で{帰|かえ}る。
examples.english: I'm leaving at regular time today.

examples.japanese: {定時|ていじ}に{上|あ}がれるのは{珍|めずら}しい。
examples.english: It's rare to be able to leave on time.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{定時|ていじ}{退社|たいしゃ}を{推奨|すいしょう}する{会社|かいしゃ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Recently, more companies are encouraging employees to leave on time.

examples.japanese: {定時|ていじ}に{発車|はっしゃ}します。
examples.english: It departs at the scheduled time.

examples.japanese: バスは{定時|ていじ}{通|どお}りに{来|き}た。
examples.english: The bus came right on schedule.

examples.japanese: {定時|ていじ}{運行|うんこう}を{維持|いじ}するために、{鉄道|てつどう}{会社|がいしゃ}はさまざまな{工夫|くふう}をしている。
examples.english: Railway companies make various efforts to maintain on-time service.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{定|てい} (fixed, determined) + {時|じ} (time)

WORKPLACE USAGE:
「{定時|ていじ}で{上|あ}がる」(to leave at regular time) or 「{定時|ていじ}{退社|たいしゃ}」is the expression for leaving work without overtime.

RELATED WORK TERMS:
- {残業|ざんぎょう} - overtime work
- {退勤|たいきん} - leaving work
- {勤怠|きんたい} - attendance/time management

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定時|ていじ}で{帰|かえ}る/{上|あ}がる - to leave at regular time
- {定時|ていじ}{退社|たいしゃ} - leaving work on time
- {定時|ていじ}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}う - to make it on time
